name: Kurono Azusa
source:
Work: Artist
Hobby: Stargazing

Azusa is an easygoing and cheerful guy who can be a bit mischievous. He loves to shop, play arcade games, cook, and has an eye for designer brands. He cares about his brother Toru, but is reluctant to talk about anything in his past, especially his parents.
translation:
Work: Artist
Hobby: Stargazing

Azusa is an easygoing and cheerful guy who can be a bit mischievous. He loves to shop, play arcade games, cook, and has an eye for designer brands. He cares about his brother Toru, but is reluctant to talk about anything in his past, especially his parents.
